notes.title: OUT NOW - Heroes Against Time has just been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/0155fa0d7ef36bb1fa851f38db624d498693342e.png[/img]

[h1]Heroes Against Time is available now[/h1]

I'm really looking forward to players discovering all the new additions I've been working on these last few months; including the new relics, tiles, maps, enemies, characters and events (!!!)

I even added a few additional last second palettes this week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/a913d9f237ec676c8b38681c9b7009c872148f9c.png[/img]

You can get Heroes Against Time here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667720/Heroes_Against_Time/

If you enjoyed the game, please be sure to leave a kind review! 
And if you're struggling with anything, feel free to ask for help or share useful feedback in the Discord and Steam forums.

Thank you for reading this far! Hope you have a blast playing the game 😁
-David


P.S.

If you can't join the Discord and want the palette code for it; it's "Bonfire" (press the Enter key afterwards). Enjoy the palette! 😊

notes.title: Progress Update | Releasing on the 18th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/94f0f3b6b1e15003d96f0054f44919ee864a2b6d.png[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
I've been working hard on the new content for the game over the last few months - it includes two brand new sets of events and characters with their own unique abilities, new relics, and some new tiles with fun mechanics to spice up your runs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/1d7f9cebf8c739209bb2dd2dc1bbe5a86ef90cb3.png[/img]

I've also been working on some new maps, each with their own gimmick and enemies to make things more difficult and interesting...!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/e14bdc7ba8938c2ff6e44354ebad47fb3e691acc.png[/img]


[h1]Delaying Release a tiny bit[/h1]

As some of you might have noticed, I delayed the release of the game a couple of times throughout development due to unexpected events;

Originally, I wanted to release on August 5th! But then a war happened where I live, and I had a tough time maintaining the same pace of progress due to being woken up by sirens in the middle of the night.

So I figured I'd delay to the 28th of August... up until a few days ago!

The game is already a ton of fun, but I realized there's still some last second fixes and additions to make it the experience it should be, and that'd be better for the game if I release it calmly after everything is fixed instead of anxiously rushing to get everything ready on the last second (and breaking the game in the process!).

So I'm currently aiming to release on the 18th of September, in a few weeks from now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/e00bd8e14492edfbdf938c2df8b25de23daa781a.png[/img]

I hope you're as excited for Heroes Against Time's launch as I am. 
Thank you for reading!

-David

notes.title: Everything About "Heroes Against Time!"
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AFhvBtJ2dR4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What is "Heroes Against Time"?[/h1]
A unique roguelite which relies on drafting allies and navigating carefully. You're in a race against time (quite literally) where you're trying spend your limited turns attempting to power up enough in order to face the boss at the end!

Originally, it started as a small prototype I made with a talented artist for a game jam - I thought it had enough potential to be expanded and improved, so I decided to turn into a full game that players can enjoy on Steam (and perhaps elsewhere!).

[h1]Demo Soon!!![/h1]
If Heroes Against Time sounds like your jam, please wishlist it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667720/Heroes_Against_Time/

Wishlisting will let you know when the demo is up (May 26th) and when the game releases (August 5th)!
Well, now you already know, but it's still worth wishlisting... if you dare!

[h1]Discord Community[/h1]
You can also chat with me and other players in the brand new Discord!

https://discord.gg/cvYxSAz8KJ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/ec1747902bf8a38e280a0ebb2fd7d333e7e9831d.gif[/img]

[h1]I'm also the dev on Netherguild![/h1]
I'm making "Netherguild" - a massive dungeoncrawler game which is currently in Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1464220/Netherguild/

But I figured there's no reason I can't share my time between both games (at least until Heroes Against Time releases on August 5th!), and that's what I've been doing these last couple months, with weekly update in Netherguild's discord while also quietly creating and refining Heroes Against Time. 
It's a bit of a grind but I think it's well worth it to make both games as fun as possible :D

[h1]All for now...?[/h1]
Thank you for checking out this update!! I'm going back to sleep. And then back to grinding to release the best demo possible on May 26th! So stay tuned.

See you next time!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/e90b23a058c63b9724a556dba954a8596f84c48a.gif[/img]
